analysis.summary: AnyTrack is the only one here publishing fresh how-to guides on fixing tracking. Rivals lean on landing pages, case studies, AI talk and incrementality (tests of whether ads cause sales).

points.text: AnyTrack published 5 new pages, mostly step-by-step guides on sending CRM and pipeline events to ad platforms. No rival does this in the data.
Triple Whale updated 18 older pages, mostly AI and Black Friday content. That reads as a refresh push aimed at ecommerce learners.
Northbeam and Triple Whale both push incrementality and attribution proof, while Hyros mostly publishes sales pages.

AnyTrack.play: Practical fix-it guides on server-side tracking, offline conversions, CRM events and affiliate scaling.

Hyros.play: Five sales pages, including a 40% for life agency partner offer.
Hyros.aimed: Agencies and buyers ready to purchase

RedTrack.play: Mostly refreshed landing pages for cookieless tracking, plus case studies. A 45-page launch on 2026-10-29.

Voluum.play: Affiliate case studies, webinars and a changelog. Only 2 new pages.

Triple Whale.play: Large refresh of AI, Black Friday and benchmark content for ecommerce brands.

Northbeam.play: New attribution model launch, plus guides and a case study on incrementality.

shared.title: Case studies as proof
shared.text: RedTrack (3), Voluum (4), Northbeam and Triple Whale (1 each) show customer results. Voluum leans hardest on it. AnyTrack has none in this data.

shared.title: Updating old pages over new ones
shared.text: RedTrack (12) and Triple Whale (18) mostly refreshed old pages. Voluum updated 5 against 2 new. It's a refresh push; AnyTrack's 3 updates are smaller.

shared.title: Sales pages and product news
shared.text: Hyros (5 landing pages) and RedTrack (6 landing pages) lean toward buyers. Voluum, Northbeam and Triple Whale also share product news.

gaps.title: Conversion API setup guides
gaps.text: Nobody in the data has new pages on feeding conversions to ad platforms. AnyTrack's CRM and GoHighLevel guides are early here, so it could build a series.

gaps.title: Customer case studies
gaps.text: AnyTrack has no case studies in the data, while Voluum has 4 and RedTrack 3. Affiliate proof with real numbers is open to AnyTrack.

gaps.title: Ad blocker and data gap fixes
gaps.text: AnyTrack's Meta vs Shopify gap guide and ad blocker comparison are unique. No rival covers troubleshooting data loss, so AnyTrack could own it.

versus.Hyros: Publishes only sales pages and a partner offer. AnyTrack teaches more, with 6 how-to guides, but has far fewer sales pages.
versus.RedTrack: Updates many landing pages and runs case studies. AnyTrack publishes more new how-to content, while RedTrack has more proof and a bigger refresh push.
versus.Voluum: Leans on case studies, webinars and a changelog. AnyTrack offers more practical guides and has no case studies in this data.
versus.Triple Whale: Publishes broad ecommerce and AI content, mostly updates. AnyTrack is narrower, focused on tracking fixes for performance marketers and affiliates.
versus.Northbeam: Focuses on a new attribution model and incrementality. AnyTrack covers setup and troubleshooting, and has nothing on incrementality in this data.
